2608.12953.title: Unifying Depth and Width Pruning for LLMs via Binary Knapsack Optimization
2608.12953.paper_summary: Structured pruning is a promising approach for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet existing methods rely heavily on greedy heuristics that produce myopic decisions, and often fail to precisely meet target compression budgets. We present SNIPER, a two-stage structured pruning framework that solves a knapsack optimization over coarse-granularity components to yield conditionally optimal parameter allocations with respect to fixed importance estimates, followed by a fine-grained pruning stage to meet strict budget constraints. We introduce the Compression Ratio Adherence Factor (CRAFT) to quantify budget fidelity, showing that while existing pruners deviate from target compression ratios by up to 33%, SNIPER achieves near-exact adherence with a CRAFT score of 0.98. Evaluations across four diverse architectures over a set of 18 tasks spanning five domains demonstrate SNIPER's consistent improvements in average performance retention and task-level stability over six state-of-the-art pruners. Across all pruning configurations, SNIPER achieves an excellent mean rank of 1.25, indicating its robust cross-architectural generalizability and excellent reliability.
2608.12953.paper_summary_zh: 結構化修剪是一種有前景的方法，用於壓縮大型語言模型（LLMs），然而現有的方法在很大程度上依賴貪婪啟發式，這會產生短視的決策，並且常常無法精確滿足目標壓縮預算。我們提出了SNIPER，一個兩階段的結構化修剪框架，它在粗粒度組件上解決背包優化問題，以產生相對於固定重要性估計的條件最優參數分配，然後進行細粒度修剪階段以滿足嚴格的預算約束。我們引入了壓縮比遵循因子（CRAFT）來量化預算的忠實度，顯示出現有的修剪器在目標壓縮比上偏離高達33%，而SNIPER則以0.98的CRAFT分數實現了近乎精確的遵循。在四種不同架構上對涵蓋五個領域的18個任務集進行的評估顯示，SNIPER在平均性能保留和任務級穩定性方面，相較於六種最先進的修剪器持續改善。在所有修剪配置中，SNIPER達到了1.25的優秀平均排名，這表明其強大的跨架構可泛化性和卓越的可靠性。
